fields.description: Save-block magic word; first u32 of the RAM save struct, initialized from a ROM table word and validated on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cf80 writes RAM save struct word0 (*param_1 = DAT_0802cfa4); FUN_0802cf38 validates word0 (*param_1 == DAT_0802cf64); transferred as EEPROM block 0 via FUN_08054418 into file offset 0x00; baseline logical u32@0x00 = 0xC0DE601D.
fields.name: header_magic

fields.description: Reserved header word; always zero in the baseline capture.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cf80 sets RAM save struct word1 (param_1[1]) = 0; transferred as EEPROM block 0 via FUN_08054418; baseline logical u32@0x04 = 0.
fields.name: header_reserved

fields.description: Primary paired meter value A; default 100 in both init profiles, mutable at runtime.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cf80 sets RAM save struct word2 (param_1[2]) = 100 (alternate defaults via FUN_0802cfac table words); transferred as EEPROM block 1 via FUN_08054418; baseline logical u32@0x08 = 100.
fields.name: meter_current

fields.description: Primary paired meter value B; default 100 in both init profiles, mutable at runtime.
fields.evidence: FUN_0802cf80 sets RAM save struct word3 (param_1[3]) = 100 (alternate defaults via FUN_0802cfac table words); transferred as EEPROM block 1 via FUN_08054418; baseline logical u32@0x0C = 100.
fields.name: meter_max

fields.description: Second half-word of the block-2 trailer; 0xFFFF unset/default marker in the baseline capture.
fields.evidence: Second u16 of EEPROM block 2: FUN_08054418 unpacks each 8-byte block into 4 u16s at param_2+0..+6, so file offsets 0x10/0x12 are struct+0x10/+0x12; adjacent to the validated u16 at struct+0x10 (FUN_0802cf38); baseline logical u16@0x12 = 0xFFFF.
fields.name: slot_state

fields.description: Second magic word opening the record section; first word of EEPROM block 2 upper half.
fields.evidence: First word of the 8-byte chunk at file offset 0x10-0x17 upper half, transferred by FUN_08054418 block reads (block index 2 -> struct/file offset 0x10); baseline logical u32@0x14 = 0xC0DE603D.
fields.name: section_magic

fields.description: Trailer half-word preceding the duplicated adjustment value; checksum algorithm for this word is not identified, so it is kept as a plain field.
fields.evidence: Non-blank u16 inside EEPROM blocks transferred by FUN_08054418/FUN_080544dc (8-byte blocks, 64 blocks over 512 bytes); sits immediately before the crc-covered record starting at file offset 0x68; baseline logical u16@0x66 = 0x6BFA.
fields.name: record_a_value

fields.description: Record adjustment value (raw LE bits of float ~0.63134); duplicated at record_b_adjust.
fields.evidence: Non-blank u32 inside EEPROM blocks transferred by FUN_08054418/FUN_080544dc; first word of the crc16_xmodem-covered range [0x68, 0xBA) verified against record_crc; baseline logical u32@0x68 = 0x3F219FC2.
fields.name: record_a_adjust

fields.description: Record adjustment value duplicate (raw LE bits of float ~0.63134); mirrors record_a_adjust but is an independent record field, not a backup copy.
fields.evidence: Non-blank u32 inside EEPROM blocks transferred by FUN_08054418/FUN_080544dc; immediately follows the record_crc stored word at file offset 0xBA; baseline logical u32@0xBC = 0x3F219FC2, identical to record_a_adjust.
fields.name: record_b_adjust
